ReTzar, a fan remake of Tzar: The Burden of the Crown.

Run ReTzar.exe. The first time, choose the folder where Tzar is installed
(GOG, Steam or CD, any language): ReTzar makes its game data from it and
keeps them here, in ReTzar.dat, with your settings and saves.

Windows may say that it protected your PC, since the game isn't signed:
click "More info", then "Run anyway".

Source code and help: https://github.com/ColCarlo/ReTzar
License: GPL-3.0-or-later (see LICENSE.txt). An unofficial fan project,
not affiliated with the makers of Tzar.
